<!-- Fixture text for testing the site. It is not a page of the wiki and never ships. -->

Two linemen start on the same defender and read his movement.

## The progression

1. Both linemen step toward the defender.
2. The lineman who is not needed moves on to the next level.
3. The other lineman finishes the block.
